Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.controllerBody: {associationName} is the data controller for the information on this site. If you have questions, contact us at {contactEmail}.
dataItems: Name, email address and profile picture from your Google account when you sign in.
Nickname, title, fun title, bio and birthday — if you fill them in.
Which events you have signed up for and attended.
Privacy.dataNote: If you sign in with Google without being a member, we store nothing about you in our database.
Privacy.whyBody: To run the association: show who the members are, plan events and keep track of who is coming. The legal basis is the membership itself and the association's legitimate interest in organising its activities.
Privacy.whoBody: Only signed-in members. The information is not public, is not shared outside the association, is never sold, and is not used for marketing.
Privacy.whereBody: In a database hosted by Supabase on servers in Stockholm, within the EU. The site itself runs on Vercel.
Privacy.retentionBody: For as long as you are a member. If you leave, we may keep your name and event history as part of the association's record — but you can always ask for everything to be deleted.
rightsItems: Find out what information we hold about you.
Complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) if you think we are getting it wrong.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use exactly one necessary cookie, to keep you signed in. No analytics, no tracking, no advertising.
Privacy.contactBody: Write to {contactEmail} and we will help you.

MembershipPrompt.title: A few words from one of our founders
paragraphs: If you are reading this, the cops have kicked the door in, found my 5 petabyte drive, and I am doing time.
No, only joking. Let us take a more serious tone.

Now thirty and more or less freshly divorced, I have realised that male companionship is all you really have in this world. It should not be neglected — and as we scatter across the world, Gothenburg, Copenhagen, London, Bjuv(?), it will matter more than ever to have some structured glue holding a group as good as this one together.

Life is still full of activity, booze and women. But a day will come when the dementia kicks in, the knee gives out on the hockey, and one's French wife has passed away in a tragic e-scooter-related swimming accident in Högsbo.
In short: friendship and community are a seed which I, as the association's first self-appointed President, Seth Ruydell style, intend to water and tend with care.
The first concrete step I am taking is this website. Here I — and hopefully YOU — will create and schedule events.
There is already plenty in the works. The idea is events for us, but also for those close to us. Nobody can think of everything, but everyone can think of something. A dog, for instance. Or a table.
I have big plans for this fine association: serious merch, a standing annual meet-up, and trips. Maybe even a shared stock pool where we save towards a trip together. Let us see where this takes us.
So: welcome to association life. YOUR membership is already booked.
